user.title: Add Tapo devices
user.description: Local mode finds your devices by asking them directly on your network. It needs the subnets your devices are on and UDP port 20002 reachable from Home Assistant.

menu_options.local: Find devices on my network (recommended, no cloud)

cloud.title: Sign in to TP-Link cloud
cloud.description: Sign in with your TP-Link/Tapo account. The password is only used to add your devices to TP-Link Smart Home and is not stored in the config entry.

data_description.username: The email address of your TP-Link/Tapo account.
data_description.password: The password of your TP-Link/Tapo account.

local.title: Find devices on your network
local.description: Enter your TP-Link/Tapo account email and password. The email only filters the devices to those owned by your account, and nothing is sent to TP-Link's cloud. The password is only used to add your devices to TP-Link Smart Home and is not stored in the config entry.

data_description.username: The email address of your TP-Link/Tapo account. Only devices owned by this account are added.
data_description.password: The password of your TP-Link/Tapo account, used to log in to the devices on your network.
data_description.subnets: Networks to search, as comma-separated CIDRs such as 192.168.1.0/24. Up to 4096 addresses in total.

data_description.code: The 6-digit verification code from the email.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to TP-Link cloud again
reauth_confirm.description: Your TP-Link Smart Home devices keep working; the password is only needed to find new devices and fix changed addresses. Enter the password for {username}.

data_description.password: The password of your TP-Link/Tapo account.

pick_devices.title: Choose devices
pick_devices.description: Ticked devices are added to TP-Link Smart Home. Unticked devices are ignored.

data_description.devices: The devices to add to TP-Link Smart Home.

discovery_confirm.title: New Tapo device found
discovery_confirm.description: Found {model} at {host}. Confirming sends your TP-Link account password to this device so it can be added to TP-Link Smart Home. Only confirm if you recognise it.

progress.sweeping: Looking for your Tapo devices on the network.
progress.onboarding: Adding your devices to TP-Link Smart Home.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the TP-Link cloud. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
error.invalid_subnets: Enter one or more private IPv4 networks such as 192.168.1.0/24, separated by commas.
error.not_private: Only private networks (such as 192.168.1.0/24) can be searched.
error.too_many_hosts: Too many addresses. Search at most 4096 addresses in total, for example sixteen /24 networks.

abort.already_configured: This account or device is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same TP-Link account that was originally configured.
abort.device_added: The device was added to TP-Link Smart Home.
abort.auth_failed: The device rejected your TP-Link account password. Add it from TP-Link Smart Home instead.
abort.identity_mismatch: The device at that address is not the one that was found. Nothing was sent.
abort.password_needed: The password is no longer in memory. Reload Tapo Onboard and enter your password again.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device. It will be offered again after the next restart.

create_entry.default: Added: {added}. Needs your confirmation: {confirm}. Already configured: {already}. Failed: {failed}{failed_devices}.

cloud_auth.message: Your TP-Link Smart Home devices keep working. The TP-Link cloud rejected the stored sign-in; reauthenticate to resume the inventory.

rate_limited.message: Your TP-Link Smart Home devices keep working. The TP-Link cloud rate-limited requests; retrying later.

cloud_unavailable.message: Your TP-Link Smart Home devices keep working. The TP-Link cloud is unreachable; retrying later.

tpap_firmware_detected.title: Tapo device uses new firmware (TPAP)
tpap_firmware_detected.description: These devices switched to TP-Link's newer TPAP login, which TP-Link Smart Home cannot use yet: {devices}. To use them here, open the Tapo app and turn on Me > Tapo Lab > Third-Party Compatibility. The devices keep working in the Tapo app.
